epd_cz04_init.message0: initialize 4-grey e-paper %1 width %2 height %3 CS %4 DC %5 RST %6 BUSY %7 SCK %8 MOSI %9
epd_cz04_init.tooltip: Initialize the four-grey e-paper (CZ04), 2.13" 104×212 by default. When the board's display config names this panel, toolbox blocks start with its resolution and pins. The canvas starts white, text black

epd_cz04_set_rotation.tooltip: Canvas orientation: portrait 104×212, landscape 212×104. Affects later drawing only

epd_cz04_clear_ghosting.tooltip: Wipe ghosting with alternating full black and white refreshes; each round is two full refreshes (over ten seconds). The panel ends white, the canvas is kept

epd_cz04_frame.tooltip: Prepare the canvas as selected, run the drawing blocks inside, then do one full refresh (several seconds)

epd_cz04_display.tooltip: Push the canvas to the e-paper. Drawing blocks only change the canvas; a refresh takes several seconds

epd_cz04_clear.tooltip: Fill the canvas with one color and refresh immediately

epd_cz04_fill_screen.tooltip: Fill the whole canvas with one color (no refresh)

epd_cz04_draw_pixel.tooltip: Draw one pixel on the canvas; anything off screen is clipped

epd_cz04_draw_line.message0: e-paper %1 line X1 %2 Y1 %3 X2 %4 Y2 %5 color %6
epd_cz04_draw_line.tooltip: Draw a straight line on the canvas

epd_cz04_draw_rect.message0: e-paper %1 rectangle X %2 Y %3 width %4 height %5 color %6 %7
epd_cz04_draw_rect.tooltip: Draw a rectangle from its top-left corner (X, Y), outline or filled

epd_cz04_draw_circle.message0: e-paper %1 circle center X %2 Y %3 radius %4 color %5 %6
epd_cz04_draw_circle.tooltip: Draw a circle centered at (X, Y), outline or filled

epd_cz04_set_text_color.tooltip: Color of Latin text and digits, transparent background

epd_cz04_set_text_size.tooltip: Scale Latin text and digits by a whole number

epd_cz04_set_font.tooltip: Font for Latin text and digits. The default font is placed by its top-left corner, the others by the text baseline

epd_cz04_set_cursor.tooltip: Start point of the next Latin text

epd_cz04_print.tooltip: Write Latin text, digits or a variable at the cursor (use the Chinese text block for Chinese)

epd_cz04_cn_text.message0: e-paper %1 at X %2 Y %3 show Chinese text %4 font %5 color %6
epd_cz04_cn_text.tooltip: Show mixed Chinese and Latin UTF-8 text; (X, Y) is the bottom-left baseline, background transparent. Large digits contain only digits and : - . /

epd_cz04_draw_weather.message0: e-paper %1 at X %2 Y %3 draw weather icon %4 color %5
epd_cz04_draw_weather.tooltip: Draw a 32×32 weather icon from its top-left corner (X, Y); lines only, background transparent

epd_cz04_draw_image.message0: e-paper %1 at X %2 Y %3 draw image %4 color %5
epd_cz04_draw_image.tooltip: Draw the lit pixels of the image in the given color; other pixels keep the canvas as it is

epd_cz04_image_portrait.tooltip: Full-screen portrait monochrome image; draw it or import a picture

epd_cz04_image_landscape.tooltip: Full-screen landscape monochrome image, use with landscape orientation

epd_cz04_width.tooltip: Canvas width in the current orientation (portrait 104, landscape 212)

epd_cz04_height.tooltip: Canvas height in the current orientation (portrait 212, landscape 104)

epd_cz04_color.tooltip: One of the four grey levels of the e-paper
